paragraphs.zh:
发明名称
一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法
paragraphs.en: Title of invention: Purification method for a tembotrione product
paragraphs.notes: NAME NOTE: the three-character Chinese substance name is the herbicide tembotrione, and it is translated that way everywhere in this file. This is an identification, not a transliteration. The evidence is printed inside this same patent, on description page p03, which this page cannot see: [0003] gives CAS number 335104-84-2, [0004] gives the molecular formula C17H16ClF3O6S, [0005] gives molecular weight 440.88, and [0007]/[0008] draw the structure as the 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-methylsulfonylbenzoyl cyclohexane-1,3-dione. All four agree on tembotrione. The published English title of this patent is 'Purification method of tembotrione product', and the bibliographic record for this run carries the same identification. NEAR MISSES, deliberately excluded: sulcotrione (C14H13ClO5S, 328.77) and mesotrione are different herbicides in the same triketone class, each with its own distinct Chinese name; neither name is used anywhere in this file. The three-character name is complete as printed and is the name the whole document uses; an earlier reading of this page treated the absence of a longer four-character form as evidence against the identification, which was the wrong test.

paragraphs.zh:
摘要
一种环磺酮产品的纯化方法，方法包括以下步骤：1）将环磺酮产品溶解在含水溶液中，升温；2）加入吸附剂，进行保温、热过滤；3）控温调节含水溶液pH至3以下，降温、从溶液中结晶出纯化的环磺酮。本发明的磺酮产品的纯化方法，可大大降低磺酮产品中氰化物杂质的含量，提高了产品的纯度，通过将纯化前的环磺酮产品与纯化后的产品进行Ames检测，原本氰化物杂质含量由1327ppm降至100ppm以下。
paragraphs.en: Abstract. A method for purifying a tembotrione product, the method comprising the following steps: 1) dissolving the tembotrione product in an aqueous solution and raising the temperature; 2) adding an adsorbent, then holding the temperature and hot-filtering; 3) adjusting the pH of the aqueous solution to below 3 under temperature control, then cooling and crystallising the purified tembotrione out of the solution. The purification method for the tembotrione product of the present invention can greatly reduce the content of cyanide impurities in the tembotrione product and raises the purity of the product; by subjecting the tembotrione product before purification and the product after purification to an Ames test, the cyanide impurity content originally at 1327ppm was reduced to below 100ppm.
paragraphs.notes: Punctuation verified against the text layer character by character: the abstract uses the FULL-WIDTH comma, enumeration comma, semicolon, colon and full stop throughout, and a full-width closing parenthesis after each step number, with half-width Latin only in 'pH', 'Ames', '1327ppm' and '100ppm'. NAMING SLIP IN THE PRINTED ABSTRACT (flagged, not resolved): the substance is tembotrione throughout, but the abstract prints its full three-character Chinese name only three times and then twice prints a two-character short form with the leading character missing, in the clause about the purification method of the present invention reducing the cyanide impurity content. That short form is the patent's own slip rather than a second substance, and the same slip recurs later in the description; both occurrences are translated 'tembotrione' here, with the missing leading character recorded rather than silently tidied away. The Chinese in the zh field is untouched. CHEMISTRY CAVEAT (flagged, not resolved): the sentence attributes a cyanide impurity content in ppm to an Ames test. An Ames test is a bacterial mutagenicity assay and does not measure impurity concentration, so either the ppm figures come from a separate analytical assay that the abstract does not name, or the sentence is compressed. Translated literally; must be checked against the description pages. The 1327ppm to below 100ppm figures are the headline claim of the patent and are reproduced exactly as printed.

discrepancies.what: The substance is tembotrione throughout, but the printed abstract names it two different ways: twice it drops the leading character of the three-character Chinese name and prints a two-character short form instead.

discrepancies.text_says: The (54) title and the first half of the (57) abstract print the full three-character name; the clause beginning 'the purification method of the present invention' then prints the short form twice, with the leading character missing. Both name tembotrione, identified from CAS 335104-84-2, C17H16ClF3O6S, 440.88 and the structure drawn at [0007]/[0008] on description page p03. The short form is the patent's own slip and it recurs at [0026]; it is not a second substance and it is not sulcotrione or mesotrione.

discrepancies.what: The abstract credits an Ames test with producing a cyanide impurity figure in ppm, which is not what an Ames test measures.
